strings.zh: 我是个收集精灵图鉴的爱好者,{NEWLINE}不过我的训练家等级太低,{CLEAR}好多珍惜的精灵都遇不到。{CLEAR}但是像你这么有潜力的训练家{CLEAR}肯定能收集齐精灵图鉴吧！
strings.en: I love collecting Pokédex entries, but{NEWLINE}my Trainer rank is too low. I never run{CLEAR}into lots of the rare Pokémon.{SCROLL}But a Trainer with as much potential as{NEWLINE}you can surely complete the Pokédex!
strings.notes: 0496 is the Game Freak office in the Celadon Condominiums (vanilla); the hack adds the author Alex (#32–38).

strings.zh: 哇,好厉害！{NEWLINE}你收集齐了城都地区的{CLEAR}全部精灵图鉴啊！{SCROLL}谢谢你让我看到了这么齐全的图鉴,{NEWLINE}这个送给你吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Wow, amazing! You’ve completed the{NEWLINE}whole Johto Pokédex!{SCROLL}Thanks for showing me such a complete{NEWLINE}Pokédex. Please take this!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哇哦,好厉害！{NEWLINE}终于把精灵图鉴{CLEAR}全部集齐了啊！{SCROLL}恭喜你！你真是{NEWLINE}百年一遇的天才啊！{CLEAR}真的真的,不是骗你哦！{CLEAR}作为证据,我把图鉴狂热者的称号{CLEAR}给你作为表彰！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Wow, amazing! You finally completed the{NEWLINE}Pokédex!{SCROLL}Congratulations! You really are a{NEWLINE}once-in-a-century genius! Really,{CLEAR}really, I’m not kidding! As proof, I{CLEAR}hereby award you the title of{CLEAR}Pokédex Fanatic!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 要把图鉴全部填满{NEWLINE}是件很累人的事情吧？{SCROLL}但是真正宝贵的是,{NEWLINE}为了集齐图鉴{CLEAR}而周游全国{CLEAR}所花费的时间。{SCROLL}你真的是个人才！{SCROLL}没有骗你哦！
strings.en: Filling the whole Pokédex must have been{NEWLINE}exhausting, right? But what’s truly{CLEAR}precious is the time you spent traveling{CLEAR}all over the country to complete it. You{CLEAR}really are something! I’m not kidding!
strings.notes: US 0503/3 | RV023: meaning: praise is of the player, not the speaker (D-1856)

strings.zh: 我们家那口子啊,{NEWLINE}一旦工作起来就完全不理人。{CLEAR}不过他的工作最近好像快完成了,{CLEAR}这之后总该有时间陪陪我和孩子了吧。
strings.en: Once my husband gets to work, he{NEWLINE}ignores everyone completely.{SCROLL}But it seems his work is almost finished.{NEWLINE}After that, surely he’ll have time for{CLEAR}me and the kids.

strings.zh: 啊……呼！
strings.en: Ah... Phew!

strings.zh: 你好啊,看你风尘朴朴的样子,{NEWLINE}离开家旅行也有段时间了吧。{CLEAR}对于这段旅途,你的感觉如何呢？
strings.en: Hello there. You look like you’ve been{NEWLINE}on the road for a while, away from home.{SCROLL}How do you feel about your journey so{NEWLINE}far?

strings.zh: 我是音像设计师,{SCROLL}是为游戏音乐作曲的工作。{SCROLL}要是你把关东的8个{NEWLINE}道馆徽章都集齐的话,{CLEAR}我会给你样好东西哦。
strings.en: I am the Sound Designer!{NEWLINE}I compose music for games.{SCROLL}I’ll give you something cool if you{NEWLINE}manage to collect all eight{CLEAR}Kanto Badges and show them to me.
strings.notes: US 0503/7 | RV023: omission: 为游戏音乐作曲 = music for games

strings.zh: 我是音像设计师,{SCROLL}是为游戏音乐作曲的工作。{SCROLL}什么,你！{NEWLINE}把关东道馆徽章{CLEAR}都收集齐了！？{SCROLL}真是了不起啊,{NEWLINE}作为奖励,给你样好东西。{SCROLL}
strings.en: I am the Sound Designer!{NEWLINE}I compose music for games.{SCROLL}Wow, you have collected{NEWLINE}all the Kanto Badges already!{CLEAR}That’s great!{SCROLL}I’ll give you something cool{NEWLINE}for that.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0503/8 | RV023: omission: 为游戏音乐作曲 = music for games

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}得到了ＧＢ播放器！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} received GB Sounds!

strings.zh: 说到ＧＢ就是那种竖着的,{NEWLINE}画面是黑白的,{CLEAR}可以玩初代的精灵……{CLEAR}也就是ＧＡＭＥＢＯＹ！{SCROLL}ＧＢ播放器{NEWLINE}打开开关,能把音乐改成{CLEAR}令人怀念的音色,{CLEAR}多么神奇的道具啊！{SCROLL}几乎在所有地方都能改变,{NEWLINE}所以你就去各种地方试试吧！{SCROLL}可能也有些不能改变的地方,{NEWLINE}那种地方你就忍耐一下吧！
strings.en: GB is a rectangular thing with a{NEWLINE}black-and-white screen that you used{CLEAR}to play the original Pokémon...{CLEAR}Oh, wait! That was a Game Boy!{SCROLL}Turn it on and GB Sounds will let you{NEWLINE}hear some nostalgic sounds.{SCROLL}It’s a gadget full of wonder!{NEWLINE}Try it at various places!{SCROLL}There are some places you won’t{NEWLINE}hear classic music...{SCROLL}But that’s life!

strings.zh: ＧＢ播放器好厉害啊。{NEWLINE}很多新的地方也能改变成{CLEAR}怀旧~音色。{SCROLL}你是不是领略到了{NEWLINE}我的特色呢！{SCROLL}……不过{NEWLINE}音乐不是靠眼睛能领略到的！{CLEAR}另外我再补充一点。{SCROLL}在大多的地方都能改变,{NEWLINE}在各种地方使用吧！{SCROLL}可能也有些不能改变的地方,{NEWLINE}那种地方你就忍耐一下吧！
strings.en: I find GB Sounds to be incredible!{NEWLINE}Even places that were built recently{CLEAR}have nice, classic music.{SCROLL}Behold the full extent of my passion!{SCROLL}...Did I say “behold”? What am{NEWLINE}I saying?{SCROLL}Anyway, try it at various places!{SCROLL}There are some places you won’t{NEWLINE}hear classic music...{SCROLL}But that’s life!

strings.zh: 琴音『哎呀！{VAR:0103:0}！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Lyra: Hi, {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 阿响『哦！{VAR:0103:0}！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ethan: Hey, {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 琴音『呐,听我说！{SCROLL}那边各位风趣的{NEWLINE}音像设计师{CLEAR}给我看了样好东西。{SCROLL}是个可以听到ＧＢ音乐的{NEWLINE}又怀旧又高端的机器哦！{SCROLL}说是收集齐了关东的徽章{NEWLINE}就送给我唉！{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}也去收集吧？{NEWLINE}那么,再见啦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Lyra: Guess what?{SCROLL}That Sound Designer over there{NEWLINE}showed me something cool.{SCROLL}It’s a hi-tech, retro machine to{NEWLINE}listen to music from the Game Boy!{SCROLL}He said he’ll give it to anyone{NEWLINE}who has collected all of the{CLEAR}Kanto Badges.{SCROLL}Why don’t you go for it, {VAR:0103:0}?{NEWLINE}See ya!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 阿响『呐,听我说！{SCROLL}那边各位风趣的{NEWLINE}音像设计师{CLEAR}给我看了样好东西。{SCROLL}是个可以听到ＧＢ音乐的{NEWLINE}又怀旧又高端的机器哦！{SCROLL}说是收集齐了关东的徽章{NEWLINE}就送给我唉！{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}也去收集吧？{NEWLINE}那么,再见啦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ethan: Guess what?{SCROLL}That Sound Designer over there{NEWLINE}showed me something cool.{SCROLL}It’s a hi-tech, retro machine to{NEWLINE}listen to music from the Game Boy!{SCROLL}He said he’ll give it to anyone{NEWLINE}who has collected all of the{CLEAR}Kanto Badges.{SCROLL}Why don’t you go for it, {VAR:0103:0}?{NEWLINE}See ya!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 口袋迷俱乐部
strings.en: Game Freak Club
strings.notes: 口袋迷 is the vanilla zh name for Game Freak (US lines in this bank and 0499 #0 say Game Freak); the hack calls the room 口袋迷俱乐部 → Game Freak Club.

strings.zh: 这边的电梯{NEWLINE}直达２楼屋顶。
strings.en: This elevator goes straight between{NEWLINE}the second floor and the roof.

strings.zh: 这是游戏的程序！{NEWLINE}很容易坏,千万不要碰！
strings.en: It’s the game program.{SCROLL}Messing with it could ruin it.{NEWLINE}You cannot touch it!

strings.zh: 桌子上有一只{NEWLINE}黏糊糊的盾牌精灵！
strings.en: There are Pokémon stickers stuck all{NEWLINE}over the desk!
strings.notes: D-1195: reverted to match the zh (Says a sticky 盾牌精灵 ("shield Pokémon") is on the desk; vanilla has Pokémon stickers); logged in hack_findings_import.jsonl | Hack text error fixed with user approval (D-0621, D-1496).

strings.zh: 排列着很多{NEWLINE}照片集和神话书！
strings.en: There are many photo collections{NEWLINE}and books about myths!

strings.zh: 你好啊,你能来到这里,{NEWLINE}说明你也是一个{CLEAR}非常喜欢口袋妖怪的人吧。{CLEAR}其实这里的人都是哦。{SCROLL}我从小就非常喜欢口袋妖怪的事情,{NEWLINE}记得小时候还买过许多{CLEAR}可以上发条的精灵模型,{CLEAR}可惜现在都找不到了。{SCROLL}口袋妖怪真的承载了我很多{NEWLINE}美好的童年回忆。{CLEAR}希望你能在这个地区的旅行中{CLEAR}重温以前的那份快乐吧！
strings.en: Hello there. If you’ve made it here, you{NEWLINE}must love Pokémon too. Actually,{CLEAR}everyone here does.{SCROLL}I’ve loved Pokémon since I was little. I{NEWLINE}remember buying lots of wind-up Pokémon{CLEAR}figures as a kid, but I can’t find any of{CLEAR}them now.{SCROLL}Pokémon really hold so many happy{NEWLINE}childhood memories for me. I hope your{CLEAR}journey through this region lets you{CLEAR}relive some of that old joy!

strings.zh: 我很喜欢
strings.en: I love it

strings.zh: 一般般吧
strings.en: It’s okay

strings.zh: 体验糟糕
strings.en: It’s been awful

strings.zh: 不知道,别问我
strings.en: Dunno, don’t ask me

strings.zh: 什么时候你对这段旅行{NEWLINE}有了新的感受之后,{CLEAR}可以来找我聊聊哦。
strings.en: Whenever you have new feelings about{NEWLINE}your journey, come and chat with me.

strings.zh: 没有意思吗？{SCROLL}好吧……看来出门旅行的感觉{NEWLINE}也就那样子吧。
strings.en: Not fun, huh?{SCROLL}Oh well... I guess traveling is just like{NEWLINE}that.

strings.zh: 这么说来,{NEWLINE}旅行到这里一定非常辛苦吧。{CLEAR}你能一路忍着痛苦来到这里,{CLEAR}也非常不容呢！
strings.en: So your journey here must have been{NEWLINE}really tough. Making it all this way{CLEAR}through the pain is quite something!

strings.zh: 那么你愿意对这一段旅程{NEWLINE}表示一下赞赏吗？
strings.en: So, would you like to show some{NEWLINE}appreciation for this journey?
strings.notes: zh 赞赏 (a ‘tip’ in Chinese apps); kept as ‘show some appreciation’.

strings.zh: 无论如何,{NEWLINE}谢谢你能在这里跟我相遇！
strings.en: Either way, thanks for meeting me here!

strings.zh: 谢谢你的赞赏,{NEWLINE}你的支持就是我最大的动力！
strings.en: Thanks for your appreciation. Your{NEWLINE}support is my biggest motivation!

strings.zh: 你好啊,我是起源{NEWLINE}新版本作者Alex{CLEAR}这次体验也有段时间了吧。{CLEAR}对于新版本的改进,{CLEAR}你的感觉如何呢？
strings.en: Hello there! I’m Alex, author of the{NEWLINE}new version of Origin. You’ve been{CLEAR}playing it for a while now, right?{SCROLL}How do you feel about the improvements{NEWLINE}in the new version?
strings.notes: Alex = the hack's author (as in 0816). Same choice menu #22–25.

strings.zh: 什么时候你有建议了,{NEWLINE}可以来找我聊聊哦。
strings.en: Whenever you have suggestions, come{NEWLINE}and chat with me.

strings.zh: 没有意思吗？{SCROLL}好吧……看来我还得改进改进。
strings.en: Not fun, huh?{SCROLL}Oh well... I guess I still need to keep{NEWLINE}improving it.

strings.zh: 这么说来,{NEWLINE}旅行到这里一定非常辛苦吧。{CLEAR}你能一路忍着痛苦来到这里,{SCROLL}也非常不容易呢！
strings.en: So your journey here must have been{NEWLINE}really tough. Making it all this way{CLEAR}through the pain is quite something!

strings.zh: 那么你愿意对这一版的改进{NEWLINE}表示一下赞赏吗？
strings.en: So, would you like to show some{NEWLINE}appreciation for the new version?

strings.zh: 无论如何,{NEWLINE}谢谢你能体验这部续作！

strings.zh: 谢谢你的赞赏,{NEWLINE}你的支持就是我最大的动力！
